name: Clairvoy
summary: Predicts the risk of persisting post-concussion symptoms (PPCS) from mean FA tract profiles with a pretrained logistic regression classifier and reports low or high risk.
description: Takes the FA tract profiles, keeps the tracts listed in significant_tracts.txt, averages each profile, and applies a pretrained logistic regression model; the result (low or high risk of PPCS) is shown as a message on brainlife.io and no data are written. The model was trained for concussion data; results on other populations are not meaningful.

inputs.requirements: Must include FA profiles for the tracts the classifier was trained on.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods, in press.
